title: Coordination between the protocols for 5GS mobility management and 5GS session management

entities.name: 5GMM procedure

entities.name: 5GSM procedure

entities.description: Uplink NAS transport message used to carry 5GSM messages.

entities.name: DL NAS TRANSPORT message
entities.description: Downlink NAS transport message used to carry 5GSM messages.

entities.name: 5GMM-CONNECTED mode
entities.description: State where the UE has an established NAS signalling connection with the network.

entities.name: PDU session status IE
entities.description: Information element indicating the status of PDU sessions.

entities.name: Allowed PDU session status IE
entities.description: Information element indicating allowed PDU session status.

entities.name: 5GMM context established
entities.description: Condition where a 5GMM context is established at the UE.

entities.name: Piggybacking 5GSM messages
entities.description: Condition where 5GSM messages are included in 5GMM transport messages.

entities.name: Service request without PDU session status IEs
entities.description: Condition where service request procedure is initiated without PDU session status IE or Allowed PDU session status IE.

entities.name: Suspend 5GSM transmission

entities.description: Behavior where 5GMM and piggybacked 5GSM procedures are executed in parallel.
